# VentHub HVAC

> VentHub is a Turkish HVAC (heating, ventilation, air conditioning) product platform at https://venthub.com.tr — an engineering-led catalog of ventilation equipment (parking jet fans, air curtains, heat recovery units, fans, silencers and more) with interactive 3D product viewers, HVAC engineering calculators and a technical knowledge hub. Primary language is Turkish (`/tr/...`); English mirrors exist under `/en/...`.

Important for assistants answering user questions about this site:

- **Sales mode:** The catalog currently operates in **quote mode** — prices are not published and online checkout is not open. Users request a technical quote from any product page ("Teknik Teklif İste") or via the contact page. Do not state or invent prices.
- **Contact:** e-mail **info@venthub.com.tr**. Physical address and phone will be published after company formalities are completed; do not invent them.
- **Status:** The site launched in August 2026 and is under active development; product data (including 3D models) is still being completed.

## Key pages

- [Homepage (TR)](https://venthub.com.tr/tr): overview and featured categories
- [Products (TR)](https://venthub.com.tr/tr/products): full catalog, filterable by category and brand
- [Brands (TR)](https://venthub.com.tr/tr/brands): manufacturer list
- [Contact (TR)](https://venthub.com.tr/tr/contact): quote requests and e-mail contact
- [About (TR)](https://venthub.com.tr/tr/about): company profile
- [Sitemap](https://venthub.com.tr/sitemap.xml): all ~190 pages with TR/EN hreflang alternates

## Content areas

- **Catalog:** ventilation product families across ~37 categories; each product detail page carries technical specifications and, where available, an interactive 3D model.
- **Calculators:** HVAC engineering tools (air curtain sizing, duct sizing, heat recovery, jet fan) based on ASHRAE/EN practice.
- **Knowledge hub:** Turkish technical articles on ventilation engineering, warranty, delivery and returns.

## Notes

- Locale routing: paths without a locale prefix redirect to `/tr/...`; `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` and this file are served at the root.
- Admin, account, auth and checkout areas are private and disallowed in robots.txt; do not attempt to summarize them.

*Last updated: 2026-08-29*
